materials.name: Black Granite
materials.description: Polished black granite from the Deccan: kitchen counters, pillar bases, steps and the edge of the mutram. Indestructible, and it never shows the turmeric stains.
materials.care: Wipe with mild soap; reseal flamed surfaces outdoors every few years.

materials.name: Honed Limestone Paving
materials.description: Cool, matte limestone slabs for courtyards, verandahs and garden paths — kind to bare feet in May.
materials.care: Wash with water; avoid acidic cleaners.

materials.name: Laterite Stone
materials.description: The porous red stone of the coast, used for plinths and compound walls. Breathes, weathers and looks better every monsoon.
materials.care: Leave unsealed; brush off moss once a year.

materials.name: White Marble
materials.description: Classic white marble with soft grey veins for pooja rooms, dining tops and bathroom vanities.
materials.care: Seal on installation; wipe spilled lemon and kumkum quickly.

materials.name: White Marble, Honed
materials.description: The same marble with a matte honed finish — less slippery and quieter in the light.
materials.care: Impregnating sealer; neutral stone soap.

materials.name: Travertine
materials.description: Warm banded stone used sparingly — a reception counter, a feature wall. Imported, so we save it for where it really counts.
materials.care: Seal against staining.

materials.name: Travertine, Filled
materials.description: Travertine with its pores filled for floors and wet areas.
materials.care: Neutral cleaner; refill pores as they open.

materials.name: Teak
materials.description: Golden-brown teak for doors, pillars, oonjals, rafters and dining tables. Our grandparents' doors still close perfectly — that's the spec.
materials.care: Oil once a year; keep out of standing water.

materials.name: Rosewood
materials.description: Dark, dense rosewood for inlays, heirloom chests and the one cabinet everyone admires.
materials.care: Dust with a soft cloth; avoid direct sun.

materials.name: Cane Weave
materials.description: Hand-woven cane for chairs, stools and cupboard panels — it breathes in the humidity and keeps you cool.
materials.care: Dust regularly; a damp cloth tightens loose weave.

materials.name: Red Oxide Floor
materials.description: Hand-polished cement floor coloured with red oxide — cool, seamless and glossy with age. Ask any paati: the best floor for an afternoon nap.
materials.care: Mop with water; a coconut-oil polish restores the shine.

materials.name: Polished Concrete
materials.description: A ground and polished slab for offices and studios; durable and thermally massive.
materials.care: Damp mop; re-burnish periodically.

materials.name: Raw Concrete
materials.description: Exposed concrete with visible pores for terraces and industrial-style rooms.
materials.care: Dust-sealing recommended indoors.

materials.name: Brass
materials.description: Brass for kuthuvilakkus, urulis, door studs, oonjal chains and pendant lamps. Polish it with tamarind and it shines like a festival.
materials.care: Tamarind or lemon polish; or let it patina.

materials.name: Copper
materials.description: Copper for water vessels, planters and kitchen accents — warm, antimicrobial and very photogenic.
materials.care: Clean with lemon and salt.

materials.name: Black Steel Grill
materials.description: Window grills and railings in painted mild steel — security, ventilation and a nice shadow pattern at 4 pm.
materials.care: Repaint every few monsoons.

materials.name: Clear Glass
materials.description: Clear glass for windows behind the grills and teak shutters.
materials.care: Standard glass cleaning.

materials.name: Frosted Glass
materials.description: Frosted glass for bathroom windows and partitions — privacy without losing daylight.
materials.care: Clean with water and a soft cloth.

materials.name: Athangudi Tiles
materials.description: Handmade cement tiles from the Chettinad region, poured pattern by pattern on glass. Our pattern: rings of maroon and teal around mustard flowers.
materials.care: Mop with water; wax occasionally. Gets better with age.

materials.name: Mangalore Roof Tiles
materials.description: Interlocking clay roof tiles on teak rafters. They keep the house cool and sound wonderful in the rain.
materials.care: Replace broken tiles before the monsoon.

materials.name: Glazed Green Tiles
materials.description: Small hand-glazed green tiles for kitchen and bathroom walls, with natural variation tile to tile.
materials.care: Mild detergent; seal grout joints.

materials.name: Reclaimed Brick
materials.description: Old fired-clay brick, cleaned and sealed. In renovations we keep it wherever it is sound.
materials.care: Breathable sealer; no pressure washing.

materials.name: Kanchipuram-style Silk
materials.description: Deep red silk with a gold zari border for oonjal cushions, bolsters and statement sofas.
materials.care: Dry clean only; store with neem leaves, not mothballs.

materials.name: Handloom Cotton
materials.description: Stone-coloured handloom cotton for curtains, jamakkalam rugs and loose covers.
materials.care: Machine wash cool; dry in shade.

materials.name: Ivory Cotton Weave
materials.description: A heavier ivory cotton for sofas and cushions.
materials.care: Removable covers; machine wash.

materials.name: Lime Plaster (Chunnambu)
materials.description: Traditional lime plaster — breathable, cool and naturally antibacterial. The walls of old Chettinad houses were polished with egg white and lime.
materials.care: Touch up with limewash; avoid plastic emulsions over it.

materials.name: Ochre Limewash
materials.description: Warm turmeric-ochre limewash for dados, thinnai fronts and accent walls.
materials.care: Re-wash every few years; it ages gracefully.

palettes.name: Chettinad
palettes.mood: Athangudi floors, teak pillars, brass and silk — the Mutram Veedu palette.

palettes.name: Madras Terrace
palettes.mood: Old Chennai: red oxide, brick, teak joists and lime.

palettes.name: Temple Town
palettes.mood: Madurai hospitality: granite, brass, ochre and silk.

palettes.name: Chennai Flat
palettes.mood: City apartment comfort: tiles with a pattern, cane and cotton.
